BlueYard is a small map mainly played in [[FFA]] mode. Made quite a comeback in 2021 when some players seleced it as their [[1on1]] map of choice in [[QuakeWorld Duel League Season 1]]. 

The centrally placed underwater [[LG]] can nicely eliminate enemies above controlling [[RA]]/[[MH]].
